reviews.text: Thursday, September 24th at 10am, appointment for Baby Lucky's grooming 🐕 Clipping €50 💸 He's so handsome 🤩 I highly recommend this groomer 👍🏼
Always top-notch grooming 👌 Chanel looks beautiful every time she comes to CANIBUS …

I've been taking my dogs to Canibus for 35 years now: a poodle, a Westie, and my Scottish Terrier, Hortense. They've always come home without any worries, and always well-groomed.
The owner is very kind, friendly, and attentive; she loves animals.

I highly recommend her.
Our miniature American Shepherd got a fantastic grooming session; he looked so handsome and seemed perfectly relaxed!
I've been bringing my dog ​​here for grooming for 12 years. Never disappointed with the quality-price ratio.
I do not recommend them. They charged €45 and didn't even trim the dog's nails. They left an unsightly bald patch in its fur. Definitely avoid them.
I took my dog ​​in twice for grooming and a haircut, and I was very, very satisfied with the work done; my dog ​​looked amazing.

Top-notch grooming; every time, we pick up our dog looking beautiful and calm.

Our dog is anxious, yet she's relaxed during her grooming and happy to come back every time thanks to the lady's kindness and expertise with dogs.

I'm a new customer, and I left my dog ​​with some apprehension because it's not possible to wait while the lady is working. In the end, I was very satisfied; it was exactly what I asked for. Thank you, we'll be back.
The best! My Lola is very timid, but she had a great rapport with her right from the start. Plus, for me, the prices are more than reasonable considering the time spent. I highly recommend her.
Thank you for grooming my mom's dog! The result is great!

For me, she's the best.

She does exactly what I want with my cotton, and I'm always thrilled with the results. Plus, she's very gentle and delicate.

She's very professional, which is important.

And her prices aren't too high either.
I highly recommend her.
Excellent groomer, very pleasant to work with, and good value for money. Thank you.
Perfect as always, a very warm welcome, great gentleness, and my little dog came out clean and looking brand new. I highly recommend it!

The owner is incredibly kind and patient with animals. She's also very friendly. She's been taking care of my Fripouille for 12 years... and before that, our previous pet. You can bring your dog with complete confidence! I highly recommend her!

I went there by chance with my little Spitz. It was my first time. The groomer gave us a very warm welcome.
The service was excellent. Her fur was thoroughly cleaned, and she's not shedding anymore. She got a nice little trim, just the right amount, and she looks lovely.
I'm very satisfied.
